Tomato_Early_Blight.symptoms: Brown/black concentric ring spots on older, lower leaves; yellowing around spots
treatment: Remove and destroy infected leaves immediately (do not compost)
Apply a copper-based fungicide or chlorothalonil spray every 7-10 days
Ensure good air circulation between plants (prune excess foliage)
prevention: Rotate crops (2-3 year gap for tomatoes)
Avoid overhead watering - water at soil level instead
Mulch around the base to prevent soil splash onto leaves

Tomato_Late_Blight.symptoms: Large water-soaked dark patches on leaves, white mold on undersides in humid conditions
treatment: Remove and destroy infected plants promptly - spreads fast
Apply fungicides containing chlorothalonil or copper compounds
Avoid working in the field when leaves are wet
prevention: Use resistant tomato varieties where available
Space plants for airflow, avoid overhead irrigation
Monitor closely during cool, wet weather

Potato_Late_Blight.symptoms: Dark lesions on leaves and stems, white fungal growth on leaf undersides
treatment: Destroy infected plants to stop spread
Apply approved fungicide (e.g. copper-based) preventatively in humid seasons
Harvest tubers early if blight is active in the field
prevention: Hill soil well over tubers to reduce spore contact
Rotate crops away from potatoes/tomatoes for 2+ years

Corn_Common_Rust.symptoms: Small reddish-brown raised pustules on both leaf surfaces
treatment: Apply foliar fungicide if infection is severe and early in season
prevention: Avoid dense planting to improve airflow

Apple_Scab.symptoms: Olive-green to black scabby spots on leaves and fruit
treatment: Apply fungicide sprays starting at bud break, repeat per label interval
Remove and dispose of fallen leaves in autumn to reduce spore source
prevention: Prune trees for good airflow and sun penetration

Grape_Black_Rot.symptoms: Circular brown leaf spots with dark borders, shriveled black 'mummified' berries
treatment: Remove mummified berries and infected leaves from the vine and ground
Apply fungicide from early shoot growth through fruit set
prevention: Clean up fallen leaves/fruit each season to reduce overwintering spores
Continue regular watering and fertilizing schedule
Monitor periodically for early signs of disease
